capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2024 (the page read); model years compared 2024 to 2026, nothing shows a change. BMW global release: usable energy content 81.2 kWh (eDrive40; xDrive40 and M60 share the pack per InsideEVs/ArenaEV). 2024-2027 compared: no pack change named.

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2024 (the page read); model years compared 2024 to 2026, nothing shows a change. ArenaEV: 83.9 kWh total.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: Gen5 BMW pack shared with the i4 (83.9 kWh gross), which BMW US states uses NMC-811 cells; no i5 page names the chemistry.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: ArenaEV labels the i5 battery "400V type"; the sibling i4 pack is 398.5 V (BMW US). BMW i5 pages do not state voltage.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: same pack as the i4 (83.9 gross). BMW US i4 page: anticipatory thermal management pre-conditions the battery when navigation routes to a fast charger (manual control not addressed); no i5 page names it.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2024 (the page read); model years compared 2024 to 2026, nothing shows a change. BMW global: DC up to 205 kW (InsideEVs 2027 repeats 205 kW for the 2027 i5).

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2024 (the page read); model years compared 2024 to 2026, nothing shows a change. BMW global: AC up to 11 kW standard, 22 kW optional (some markets); ArenaEV 11 kW. North America assumed 11 kW (US i7 listing says 11 kW); no US/CA i5 page read.

published_10_80_min.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2024 (the page read); model years compared 2024 to 2026, nothing shows a change. BMW global: 10 to 80 percent in around 30 minutes.
